The manufacturers are the Sekisui Heim Industry companies in Hokkaido, Tohoku, Chugoku-Shikoku and Kyushu, and factory companies such as Sekisui Heim Industry Co., Ltd.; the sales and construction companies are the regional Sekisui Heim sales companies. entries.e71e9c070e6b0b32: In Housing, while market conditions for new houses are sluggish, demand in urban areas is firm, and apartment buildings and high-priced detached houses are growing. Environment and Lifeline is affected by domestic market conditions for residential and non-residential use and by renewal demand from the nationwide priority survey of sewerage. High Performance Plastics is supported in net sales by market conditions for semiconductors and displays, products for automobiles such as interlayer films for head-up displays, and products for aircraft and drones. Medical, while the domestic medical business is firm, is affected by the testing markets in the United States and China. Looking at sales to external customers by region for the fiscal year ended March 2026, Japan was ¥891,457 million, North America was ¥143,737 million, Europe was ¥98,633 million, China was ¥90,732 million, Asia was ¥73,926 million and other was ¥10,792 million, and in High Performance Plastics, North America is larger than Japan. Products of reportable segments other than the Housing Business are mainly produced to stock.
entries.e7d255e784ad821c: Sekisui Chemical Co., Ltd. and affiliates in Japan and overseas
entries.ea942d6cbe262c15: Sekisui Polymatech Co., Ltd. is a main affiliate of the High Performance Plastics Business and Sekisui Sofran Wiz Co., Ltd. is a main affiliate of the Environment & Lifeline Business, and heat-dissipating materials (grease and sheets) and resin and rubber molded products for vehicles, and fire-resistant materials and noncombustible polyurethane, are listed among the products of each business.
entries.ef124803c51995d8: The company listed on the Osaka Securities Exchange in March 1953 and on the Tokyo Stock Exchange in April 1954. In April 2022, following the review of the Tokyo Stock Exchange's market segments, it moved from the First Section to the Prime Market.
entries.ef5777bd8e2be89e: The listing venue printed on the cover is the Tokyo Stock Exchange Prime Market. In September of the same year, 1953, the company newly established the Tokyo Plant and began manufacturing plastic molded products.
entries.ef7e3bedcdd6096f: In August 1960, the company newly established the Shiga Ritto Plant and began manufacturing vinyl chloride pipes and vinyl chloride building material products.
entries.f41642863f4e2e34: In August 2017, the company acquired management control of the Polymatech Japan Co., Ltd. (now Sekisui Polymatech Co., Ltd.) group and advanced business expansion in fields such as vehicles and transportation and the strengthening of fundamental technologies such as material compounding and processing technologies.
entries.f56bd28ea29af086: The Housing Business, centered on the manufacture, construction and sale of steel-frame and wooden unit houses, also conducts sale of land for subdivision, remodeling, the residential business and sale and construction of interiors and exteriors. The Environment and Lifeline Business manufactures, sells and also constructs piping such as vinyl chloride pipes and fittings and polyethylene pipes and fittings, rainwater storage materials, building materials and sewer pipe rehabilitation materials and methods. The High Performance Plastics Business manufactures and sells interlayer films for laminated glass, foamed polyolefin, photosensitive materials, semiconductor materials, optical films, industrial tapes, heat dissipation materials and other products. The Medical Business manufactures and sells clinical diagnostic reagents, automatic analyzers, blood collection tubes, pharmaceutical active ingredients and intermediates and other products. In the Other Business, it handles film-type lithium-ion batteries and other products, and Sekisui Solar Film Co., Ltd. was established in January 2025 for the purpose of design, manufacture and sale of film-type perovskite solar cells.
entries.f6c474524f79c5c5: This was an acquisition that expanded the foundation of the Environment & Lifeline Business.
entries.f7439d74b3f99f48: Sekisui Aerospace Corporation, AIM Group USA Inc., AIM Aerospace Renton, Inc. and AIM Aerospace Sumner, Inc. are now listed as main affiliates of the High Performance Plastics Business.
entries.ff9f9f4b1bc795aa: The business manages rental housing, resells purchased homes and others.
